bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 2.1 million views on one reel. The only thing to buy is your time.
beats.text: Your reels travel far beyond your 13K followers: one passed 2.1 million views, two more passed 150,000, and YouTube adds 73.2K subscribers. But the only paid step is a Setmore booking: 20 minutes for $150, an hour for $350.

beats.title: “Comment WEALTH” already works.
beats.text: Your reels end with “Comment WEALTH” or “Comment SAVE”, one reel drew 359 comments, your newsletter collects emails, and YouTube members pay to join. These people want a plan from you, not one more app review.

beats.title: Selling minutes caps you at your calendar.
beats.text: Every call is a one-off Q&A about side hustles, Airbnb or investing apps, and then the person is gone. There's no program that takes them from “I watched your video” to an actual financial game plan, so every sale starts from zero.

beats.title: “I'd rather share tools than sell coaching.” Do both.
beats.text: The reviews and tool links stay, they're how people find you. The coaching sits on top for viewers who want you to look at their numbers with them, over weeks instead of one 20-minute call.
beats.quote: “I don’t just talk about money. I put my own money on the line.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your income, savings and any investments ready.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Kevin

preCallEmails.subject: There's no single path to financial freedom
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people don't need another money tip. They need a plan that fits their income, their goals and their life.

That's what the coaching is built on: your numbers first, then a game plan for earning, saving and investing.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Kevin

preCallEmails.subject: "I already booked a 1-on-1 call"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great. Then you know how I work.

A single call answers questions. The coaching builds the plan and follows up while you put it into action, so it doesn't stay a list of ideas.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Kevin

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Kevin

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Kevin's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Kevin

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Kevin
